Split the hoped-for socialist society's distinct outcomes while retaining the working-class-government and organizing conditions and organizational-goal modality. Anchored the three priorities to the 2024 program and separated them. Preserved grassroots movement-building as a declared DSA commitment as well as a predicted capacity.

claims.claim_text: With working-class government, strong unions and social movements organizing everywhere, DSA hopes to build a socialist society where people take priority over profit.
Under those conditions, DSA hopes to guarantee basic needs.
Under those conditions, DSA hopes to place the largest corporations under public ownership and democratic control.
Under those conditions, DSA hopes to secure worldwide peace.
Under those conditions, DSA hopes workers worldwide will unite in common struggle to construct socialism globally.
Defeating the far right is a top DSA priority in its 2024 program.
Protecting working-class rights from the United States to Palestine is a top DSA priority in its 2024 program.
Fighting for democracy is a top DSA priority in its 2024 program.
Through grassroots struggles, DSA commits to building a movement capable of challenging the capitalist class and building an equal, democratic and liberated world.
